intent.raw_request: 完成 Rudder 第一方后端及 Agent tooling 的全 Rust 迁移。最终目标不是 Node orchestration + Rust sidecar，而是 Actix Web 接管核心 HTTP/WebSocket 服务；SQLx 接管 PostgreSQL 查询、事务和迁移；第一方业务服务、鉴权/session、调度器、workers、Agent Run、Chat/Side Chat、Automation、provider adapters、常用后端组件、CLI 和 MCP 均由 Rust 实现，对应 Node 后端退出运行时。同时纳入第一方 identity、analytics collector、managed MCP、嵌入式 PostgreSQL 生命周期，以及拥有产品状态的维护和更新恢复工具。保留 React、前端工具、Electron shell，以及用户选择的外部 provider CLI、MCP、Local App 和插件组件。按 Phase 0–7 连续推进，优先接通已有 Actix/read 能力；每个切片都包括真实入口、鉴权、事务、审计、副作用、恢复、相关 CLI/MCP 和旧 writer 的退出。禁止生产双写、陈旧 writer 继续写入、静默 Node fallback、用 Node 子进程包装旧实现，以及把后端业务转移进 Electron/bootstrap。最终必须证明移除旧第一方 Node 后端资产后，安装后的 UI/API/CLI/MCP、数据库升级、调度、执行、恢复和支持平台仍通过验收。分别报告 implementation_complete、release_ready 和 production_verified；没有实际生产证据，不得声称已上线完成。未经额外授权，不删除真实用户数据、不迁移生产数据库、不发布 stable、不切换生产流量、不购买服务。开始推进。
corrections: 记得先把这个 plan 写进 doc/plans。
调整策略，让开发更快一点：很多真实环境可以先迁移进来，因为单纯离线测试和真正切进来测试完全是不一样的。可以持续地、一点一点把这些功能先接入到生产环境里，逐步替换掉，但保持可回滚并遵守旧 writer、生产双写和授权边界。
重构过程中 Main 分支时不时会有新功能或者修改进来，Rust 也要对应做好适配；在每个切片候选前刷新 origin/main、隔离同步、重跑受影响扫描，并使受影响 receipt 失效。
本 packet 只冻结 Project-Goal real-entry slice；不把它升级为完整后端、release-ready 或 production-verified。
non_goals: 不声明完整 Rust backend completion、release readiness 或 production verification。
不切换生产流量，不迁移生产数据库，不发布 stable，不删除真实用户数据。
不把 private bridge、shadow/probe invocation、CLI/MCP direct dispatch 或组织删除 409 当作旧 authority retirement。
不把 Project delete、全局 writer fence、session/revocation authority 或 outbox publisher recovery 偷渡进本 slice。

criteria: The exact candidate starts the supported Node 0.7.24 local-trusted server with disposable embedded PostgreSQL and Rust migration preflight bootstrap/current without touching user data.
Required Project-Goal mode preserves public create-with-goals behavior and provisions a Rust-owned project_goal_mutation_state with consistent project_goals and projects.goal_id projections.

A board or agent-authorized supported PATCH /api/projects/:id goal-set request reaches the private Actix bridge, SQLx transaction, and returns the existing Project response shape without a Node goal writer or duplicate route activity.

The transaction atomically persists complete goal-set replacement, primary projection, owner/version/epoch, immutable receipt, activity, and outbox state; wrong-organization goal targets and mixed updates fail closed without partial mutation.

First-party CLI and MCP Project-Goal actions use the same HTTP authority; project creation and goal replacement use direct HTTP dispatch, and MCP succeeds when its legacy CLI binary path is missing without silently falling back to a Node CLI.
Same-key replay is stable, changed payload conflicts, clear-all preserves empty-set semantics, and a complete server/database restart replays without duplicate receipt/activity/outbox rows.

Required startup hands off only explicit UUIDs from RUDDER_RUST_PROJECT_GOAL_PROJECT_IDS in one atomic allowlist transaction; a missing target or non-Node owner fails before the batch update, automatic new-project handoff requires explicit local_trusted opt-in, and unlisted existing projects remain Node-owned and fail closed under Rust required mode.
The current Rust-owned organization/project deletion boundary fails closed with the observed 409; the slice does not claim a Rust Project delete command or old-authority retirement.
